Try `Table(expand=True)` and set the last column to `ratio=1`, `no_wrap=True`, and `overflow="ellipsis"`. The ratio column is allocated from the available table width after the non-flexible columns, which should give the layout you described when the other columns fit. `expand`, `ratio`, and `no_wrap` are described in the [table docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst). For usage questions, please ask in [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
